title: Hotfix: portal/login asset cache-bust (v0.0.61 regression)
description:
Restores PipeShare login and client portal on BASE/SaaS after a bad cache-bust rewrite in v0.0.61 turned ?v= into $1… so theme CSS/JS 404'd and the portal showed "Client portal script did not load". Paths are corrected and cache-busted again.

Who is affected: anyone opening pipeshare.live (or SaaS peer) login or client portal.
changeLog: Bump portal runtime version + file-explorer addon cache-bust
login.html default product pipeshare + cache-bust for BASE branding
No functional change to Video↔DB3+META binding from v0.0.61
